symbols.name: ar
symbols.summary: AR (Attack, Release) envelope generator (useful to create percussion envelopes). `ar` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: t
params.description: trigger signal (attack is triggered when `t>0`, release is triggered when the envelope value reaches 1)

symbols.name: asr
symbols.summary: ASR (Attack, Sustain, Release) envelope generator. `asr` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: t
params.description: trigger signal (attack is triggered when `t>0`, release is triggered when `t=0`)

symbols.name: adsr
symbols.summary: ADSR (Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release) envelope generator. `adsr` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: t
params.description: trigger signal (attack is triggered when `t>0`, release is triggered when `t=0`)

symbols.name: adsrf_bias
symbols.summary: ADSR (Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release, Final) envelope generator with control over bias on each segment, and toggle for legato.

params.name: final
params.description: final level (between 0..1) but less than or equal to `sl`

params.name: b_att
params.description: bias during attack (between 0..1) where 0.5 is no bias.

params.name: b_dec
params.description: bias during decay (between 0..1) where 0.5 is no bias.

params.name: b_rel
params.description: bias during release (between 0..1) where 0.5 is no bias.

params.name: legato
params.description: toggle for legato. If disabled, envelopes "re-trigger" from zero.

params.name: t
params.description: trigger signal (attack is triggered when `t>0`, release is triggered when `t=0`)

symbols.name: smoothEnvelope
symbols.summary: An envelope with an exponential attack and release. `smoothEnvelope` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: t
params.description: trigger signal (attack is triggered when `t>0`, release is triggered when `t=0`)

symbols.name: arfe
symbols.summary: ARFE (Attack and Release-to-Final-value Exponentially) envelope generator. Approximately equal to `smoothEnvelope(Attack/6.91)` when Attack == Release.

params.name: fl
params.description: final level to approach upon release (such as 0)

params.name: t
params.description: trigger signal (attack is triggered when `t>0`, release is triggered when `t=0`)
